limitations: The fixed catalog was frozen from the full project snapshot, so app inclusion and Linux-candidate membership are transductive with respect to the cutoff.
Validation accounts come from the fixed full-snapshot split_v1 assignment; this is a restricted snapshot-label temporal test, not a prospectively sampled population.

Accepted lineage already applies the project's quarantine policy, including checks that use the complete snapshot and Frank identity overlap; the cutoff refit cannot undo that retrospective provenance.
A positive target is observed in the later Kieran snapshot; this experiment does not reconstruct historical recommendation impressions or labels beyond the accepted review timestamps.

review_body.scope: Independent review/app membership audit plus builder exact user/review/app tuple audit; no heldout review text used for fit.

review_content_two_channel_check.scope: Numerical execution verification; not a model-selection metric; does not claim bitwise equivalence or inspect all validation rankings.

review_recommendation_concentration.interpretation: Recommendation concentration is observed; generic review vocabulary or document length is not established as its cause.

sequence_model_feasibility.decision: SASRec is potentially trainable, not shown infeasible. Full model training remains a conditional follow-up, not a measured v3 candidate.
missing_prerequisites: Create and audit accepted train event sequences with stable event-time tie rules; current temporal model input stores user/app pairs, not sequences.
Freeze sequence length, negative sampling, architecture, optimizer and train/validation chronology before SASRec metrics.
Address the existing temporal experiment snapshot-label/transductive-catalog limitations; timestamp cutoff alone is not an independent historical replay.
sequence_model_feasibility.scope: A review-created timestamp is not a play-session/order event. Do not claim SASRec performance from sequence counts.

ease_normal_equation_audit.scope: Sampled Linux-row off-diagonal normal equations (G+lambda I)b=G[:,target] outside target; all self coefficients checked. Candidate rows from frozen raw co-occurrences, previously independently matched to the full Gram before builder temporary-file cleanup.

ease_lambda1000_exact.scope: Explicitly cache the same CSR transpose used by SciPy for each original multiplication; no feature or formula change.

ease_lambda100_exact.scope: Explicitly cache the same CSR transpose used by SciPy for each original multiplication; no feature or formula change.

inference: Selection uses validation only. frank results are previously observed reference evaluations.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap is exploratory after multiple candidate comparisons; not multiplicity adjusted.
